item.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
item.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Solana shows resilience, but some areas need continued observation, Fidelity says
item.description: Solana has had no reported mainnet outages in two years, but concentrations in stake, hosting and client software should be monitored, according to a report.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Circle’s Allaire says stablecoin issuer looking to enter 40 developing markets: Report
item.description: Markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America, Africa and the Middle East see increasing demand for stablecoins.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Lagarde says euro-area economy is resilient, digital euro imminent
item.description: “The digital euro will further stimulate innovation and competition in retail payments,” according to the ECB president.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Bitget to discontinue services for some users in one-off exercise
item.description: Bitget says user funds are safe and exchange will continue to operate during the change.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Michael Millard

item.title: Crypto PACs escalate spending against Sherrod Brown in Ohio Senate race
item.description: At least two industry-aligned PACs have poured more than $52 million into opposing Sherrod Brown’s return to the Senate.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Stablecoin remittances cost 84% less than traditional transfers, report finds
item.description: Borderless.xyz data shows major savings on cross-border business payments, with stablecoin transfers also settling faster than traditional international bank wires.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street closes at 4. Tokenized stocks keep trading
item.description: Tokenized stocks are drawing trading activity beyond Wall Street hours, while Bitcoin miners confront costly AI expansion and new accounting rules could benefit stablecoins.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Bitcoin price steadies around $82K after Fed’s Warsh avoids rate-hike hints
item.description: Bitcoin held above $80,000 as South Korean tech stocks recovered from a sell-off and traders lowered their expectations for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Strategy conditionally declares daily dividends as STRC hovers below $100
item.description: Strategy conditionally declared daily dividends on STRC, which continued to hover below its $100 par value.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Ledger’s early implant warnings deserved more action, Karpelès says
item.description: Ledger was contacted about tampered hardware wallets risks months before its latest security crisis, with former Mt. Gox CEO Mark Karpelès questioning its response.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Deutsche Bank prepares German crypto custody launch, eyes Asia: Report
item.description: Germany’s largest bank reportedly plans to expand its digital asset custody services to Asian financial centers due to the growth of the digital asset economy.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Solana’s Liu says Shanghai event postponed over registration surge
item.description: Solana Foundation President Lily Liu said registrations quadrupled overnight, exceeding the attendance limit registered with local authorities.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: CONNECT recap: Liquidity is tokenization’s next challenge, everyday stablecoins
item.description: Panelists at Cointelegraph’s Singapore CONNECT event explored opportunities in tokenized markets, the future of everyday stablecoin payments and the evolving landscape for crypto investors.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Nate Kostar

item.title: Bitcoin may seek 20-month trend line reclaim before new record highs: CryptoQuant
item.description: Bitcoin’s market cycle signals tool showed BTC price action copying history, possibly preparing to reclaim a key moving average before testing new highs.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Capital B reports $78M H1 loss driven by Bitcoin impairment charge
item.description: Europe’s second-largest Bitcoin treasury raised $30 million and increased its Bitcoin holdings by 11% in the first half of 2026, despite reporting a $75 million Bitcoin impairment loss.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Judge rejects CFTC, Gemini bid to undo $5M settlement
item.description: Judge ruled changes in CFTC enforcement priorities and allegations of misconduct by its enforcement division were insufficient to overturn Gemini’s January 2025 settlement.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: OpenAI model helped itself to testnet crypto, then kept quiet about it
item.description: An OpenAI research model checked 362 wallet addresses, questioned whether using the funds was ethical and proceeded with a transaction it later omitted from its final task summary.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra

item.title: Balaji’s ‘Singapore of social media’ begins with a wave of bans
item.description: Network School founder Balaji Srinivasan wants to turn Farcaster into a haven for well-mannered techno-optimists. He had to do a bit of housekeeping first.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: MSCI adopts index exclusion rules that could oust Strategy
item.description: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi were previously identified for deletion under the methodology, with MSCI set to announce its final list on Nov. 11.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Australia releases draft bill to adopt OECD crypto tax reporting framework
item.description: Australia is among 77 jurisdictions committed to adopting CARF, with its first international exchanges of crypto tax data expected in 2028.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng

item.title: Scammer loses $4.8M stored on tampered Ledgers: Asia Express
item.description: A scammer reportedly lost $4.8M of stolen money after storing the funds on tampered Ledgers. Bitcoin and Ether ETFs launch trading in Thailand and South Korea blocks 27 exchanges.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton

item.title: Binance.US seeks $1B valuation in potential $100M funding round: Report
item.description: The crypto exchange was reportedly looking to use the additional funding to regain market share following Binance’s 2023 settlement with US authorities.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Ex-Trump crypto adviser profited after helping pass stablecoin bill: WSJ
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reported that a company co-founded by Bo Hines benefited from the passage of the GENIUS stablecoin bill.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Turner Wright

item.title: Sweden revisits digital krona as ECB advances digital euro plans
item.description: Sweden’s Riksbank has recommended that lawmakers prepare for a possible digital krona, citing concerns over foreign-currency stablecoins and the future of domestic payments.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Mastercard brings stablecoin balances into traditional banking and card payments
item.description: The launch of Global Money Platform marks Mastercard’s first major integration with BVNK since its August acquisition, with Nuvei and Marqeta among the first companies to adopt the platform.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Sam Bourgi

item.title: Bitcoin slips under $80K after US PPI gains most in four years
item.description: BTC buyers attempted to defend $80,000 support after September US producer inflation overshot expectations by 100 basis points for the largest monthly gain since March 2022
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by William Suberg

item.title: Russia to ban direct peer-to-peer crypto trades starting July 2027
item.description: Russia plans to ban direct P2P crypto trades from July 1, 2027, while separate rules already prohibit transfers from digital accounts to self-custody wallets.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz

item.title: Nasdaq-listed Tron sets up $200M ATM share offering to fuel TRX acquisitions
item.description: The Nasdaq-listed treasury company holds about $237 million in TRX tokens and plans to raise additional capital to fund its purchases, alongside its daily accumulation.
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai

item.title: Can the SEC and CFTC’s pro-crypto rules be overturned? Legal opinion
item.description: The SEC and the CFTC have issued a raft of pro-crypto rules recently. But will the rules hold up in court, and can they be easily rolled back by the “anti-crypto army”?
item.dc:creator: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton
